project.description: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Project} for which this spec must be instantiated.

assetToModelRelationFilter.description:
The model monitoring job is run for the {@link ReliabilityAsset} and {@link ReliabilityMlModel} pairs in the
{@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation} specified by the {@link #assetToModelRelationFilter}, if
the model is deployed on the asset as a `CANDIDATE`.

referenceTimeRange.description:
The reference period for which a {@link ReliabilityMl.ModelOutput}s are generated in order to determine how the
model performs. This usually can correspond to the training period for the model, since the model is expected to
perform well on the training data

Use `ReliabilityMl.TimeRange.TRAIN` to use the training time range associated with a {@link ReliabilityMlModel#datasetPreparationRun},
or instead provide your own custom time range.

The model outputs from this period can be compared with the model outputs generated for the {@link #comparisonTimeRange} to
classify or monitor a model.

comparisonTimeRange.description:
The comparison period for which a {@link ReliabilityMl.ModelOutput}s are generated in order to determine how the
model performs. This will usually refer to a custom time range corresponding to the most recent live data, and the model is
expected to continue to perform as well on the live data as it does on the training data.
